notes:
## Changes
- Lock the library while you're away: press Ctrl+L, choose View › Lock, or click the new Lock button at the top of the window. A lock screen covers the library, the menus and the collection figures, and every other Video Shelf window is hidden until you unlock it.
- A playing Media Wall pauses while it's locked and carries on when you unlock. Phones and tablets keep working, and jobs such as refreshes and downloads carry on in the background.
- Unlock with your collection PIN if you've set one, otherwise with Windows Hello (your Windows PIN, fingerprint or face).
- It also locks when Windows locks or the PC sleeps. Settings › Privacy can lock it after 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes without use (off to start with, and never while a Media Wall is playing).
- If you close the app while it's locked and no collection PIN is set, it opens locked next time.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
